<?php
/**
 * Hook registration for Smart Media Markup.
 *
 * @package SmartMediaMarkup
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

/**
 * Wires the markup processor into block rendering and the block editor.
 */
final class Smart_Media_Markup {

	/**
	 * Name of the custom image block attribute.
	 */
	const ATTRIBUTE = 'smartMediaCaptionAsAlt';

	/**
	 * Registers all hooks.
	 *
	 * @return void
	 */
	public static function init() {
		add_filter( 'register_block_type_args', array( __CLASS__, 'register_attribute' ), 10, 2 );

		add_filter( 'render_block_core/image', array( __CLASS__, 'render_image' ), 10, 2 );
		add_filter( 'render_block_core/gallery', array( __CLASS__, 'render_media' ), 10, 2 );
		add_filter( 'render_block_core/cover', array( __CLASS__, 'render_media' ), 10, 2 );

		add_action( 'enqueue_block_editor_assets', array( __CLASS__, 'enqueue_editor_assets' ) );
	}

	/**
	 * Adds the `smartMediaCaptionAsAlt` attribute to the core/image block on the server.
	 *
	 * Without this, the attribute would be stripped/ignored when the block is
	 * rendered or validated through the REST API.
	 *
	 * @param array  $args       Block type arguments.
	 * @param string $block_type Block type name, including namespace.
	 * @return array
	 */
	public static function register_attribute( $args, $block_type ) {
		if ( 'core/image' !== $block_type ) {
			return $args;
		}

		if ( ! isset( $args['attributes'] ) || ! is_array( $args['attributes'] ) ) {
			$args['attributes'] = array();
		}

		$args['attributes'][ self::ATTRIBUTE ] = array(
			'type'    => 'boolean',
			'default' => false,
		);

		return $args;
	}

	/**
	 * Filters the rendered output of core/image.
	 *
	 * @param string $block_content Rendered block HTML.
	 * @param array  $block         Parsed block.
	 * @return string
	 */
	public static function render_image( $block_content, $block ) {
		if ( ! is_string( $block_content ) || '' === trim( $block_content ) ) {
			return $block_content;
		}

		$caption_as_alt = isset( $block['attrs'][ self::ATTRIBUTE ] )
			&& true === rest_sanitize_boolean( $block['attrs'][ self::ATTRIBUTE ] );

		return Smart_Media_Markup_Processor::process(
			$block_content,
			array(
				'caption_as_alt' => $caption_as_alt,
				'site_host'      => self::get_site_host(),
			)
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Filters the rendered output of core/gallery and core/cover.
	 *
	 * @param string $block_content Rendered block HTML.
	 * @return string
	 */
	public static function render_media( $block_content ) {
		if ( ! is_string( $block_content ) || '' === trim( $block_content ) ) {
			return $block_content;
		}

		return Smart_Media_Markup_Processor::process(
			$block_content,
			array(
				'site_host' => self::get_site_host(),
			)
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Returns the lower-cased host name of the site's home URL.
	 *
	 * @return string
	 */
	private static function get_site_host() {
		$host = wp_parse_url( home_url(), PHP_URL_HOST );

		/**
		 * Filters the host considered "internal" when deciding whether a link is external.
		 *
		 * @param string $host Host name of the site's home URL.
		 */
		$host = apply_filters( 'smart_media_markup_site_host', is_string( $host ) ? $host : '' );

		return strtolower( (string) $host );
	}

	/**
	 * Enqueues the editor script that adds the attribute and the inspector toggle.
	 *
	 * @return void
	 */
	public static function enqueue_editor_assets() {
		$asset_file = SMART_MEDIA_MARKUP_DIR . 'build/index.asset.php';

		if ( ! file_exists( $asset_file ) ) {
			return;
		}

		$asset = require $asset_file;

		wp_enqueue_script(
			'smart-media-markup-editor',
			plugins_url( 'build/index.js', SMART_MEDIA_MARKUP_FILE ),
			$asset['dependencies'],
			$asset['version'],
			true
		);

		wp_set_script_translations( 'smart-media-markup-editor', 'smart-media-markup' );
	}
}

<?php
/**
 * HTML transforms built on the WordPress HTML API.
 *
 * @package SmartMediaMarkup
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

/**
 * Pure, stateless markup transforms. No regex or DOMDocument is used to
 * parse HTML; everything goes through WP_HTML_Tag_Processor / WP_HTML_Processor.
 */
final class Smart_Media_Markup_Processor {

	/**
	 * Class added to the outer <figure>.
	 */
	const FIGURE_CLASS = 'has-smart-media';

	/**
	 * Applies all transforms to a block's rendered HTML.
	 *
	 * @param string $html    Rendered block HTML.
	 * @param array  $options {
	 *     Optional. Transform options.
	 *
	 *     @type bool   $caption_as_alt Copy <figcaption> text into an empty `alt`. Default false.
	 *     @type string $site_host      Host name treated as internal for links. Default ''.
	 * }
	 * @return string Updated HTML.
	 */
	public static function process( $html, array $options = array() ) {
		if ( ! is_string( $html ) || '' === trim( $html ) ) {
			return $html;
		}

		$options = wp_parse_args(
			$options,
			array(
				'caption_as_alt' => false,
				'site_host'      => '',
			)
		);

		$caption = '';
		if ( $options['caption_as_alt'] ) {
			$caption = self::get_caption_text( $html );
		}

		$processor        = new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );
		$tag_index        = 0;
		$allow_figure_at  = 0;
		$figure_done      = false;
		$alt_handled      = false;
		$site_host        = strtolower( (string) $options['site_host'] );

		while ( $processor->next_tag() ) {
			$tag = $processor->get_tag();

			/*
			 * 3. Outer <figure> gets the marker class. The outer figure is the
			 * first tag of the block, or (legacy aligned image markup) the
			 * first child of a leading <div class="wp-block-image">.
			 */
			if ( 0 === $tag_index && 'DIV' === $tag && true === $processor->has_class( 'wp-block-image' ) ) {
				$allow_figure_at = 1;
			}
			if ( ! $figure_done && 'FIGURE' === $tag && $tag_index === $allow_figure_at ) {
				$processor->add_class( self::FIGURE_CLASS );
				$figure_done = true;
			}

			if ( 'IMG' === $tag ) {
				// 1. Async decoding, unless the author already chose a value.
				if ( null === $processor->get_attribute( 'decoding' ) ) {
					$processor->set_attribute( 'decoding', 'async' );
				}

				// 2. Caption as alt text, only for the block's (first) image.
				if ( ! $alt_handled ) {
					$alt_handled = true;
					if ( '' !== $caption && self::is_empty_alt( $processor->get_attribute( 'alt' ) ) ) {
						$processor->set_attribute( 'alt', $caption );
					}
				}
			} elseif ( 'A' === $tag ) {
				// 4. rel="noopener" on external links, merged with existing tokens.
				$href = $processor->get_attribute( 'href' );
				if ( is_string( $href ) && self::is_external_url( $href, $site_host ) ) {
					$rel = self::merge_rel( $processor->get_attribute( 'rel' ), 'noopener' );
					if ( null !== $rel ) {
						$processor->set_attribute( 'rel', $rel );
					}
				}
			}

			++$tag_index;
		}

		return $processor->get_updated_html();
	}

	/**
	 * Returns the plain-text content of the first <figcaption>.
	 *
	 * Uses WP_HTML_Processor, which understands HTML tree semantics, and falls
	 * back to a token walk with WP_HTML_Tag_Processor if the HTML Processor
	 * cannot handle the markup.
	 *
	 * @param string $html Block HTML.
	 * @return string Normalized caption text, or '' if none.
	 */
	public static function get_caption_text( $html ) {
		$text = self::get_caption_text_with_html_processor( $html );

		if ( null === $text ) {
			$text = self::get_caption_text_with_tag_processor( $html );
		}

		return self::normalize_whitespace( $text );
	}

	/**
	 * Reads caption text with the full HTML Processor.
	 *
	 * @param string $html Block HTML.
	 * @return string|null Caption text, or null if the processor bailed.
	 */
	private static function get_caption_text_with_html_processor( $html ) {
		if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_HTML_Processor' ) || ! method_exists( 'WP_HTML_Processor', 'next_token' ) ) {
			return null;
		}

		$processor = WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment( $html );
		if ( null === $processor ) {
			return null;
		}

		$text       = '';
		$in_caption = false;
		$found      = false;

		while ( $processor->next_token() ) {
			$breadcrumbs = $processor->get_breadcrumbs();
			$inside      = is_array( $breadcrumbs ) && in_array( 'FIGCAPTION', $breadcrumbs, true );

			if ( $in_caption && ! $inside ) {
				// Left the first caption; ignore any further ones.
				break;
			}
			$in_caption = $inside;

			if ( ! $inside ) {
				continue;
			}
			$found = true;

			$type = $processor->get_token_type();
			if ( '#text' === $type ) {
				$text .= $processor->get_modifiable_text();
			} elseif ( '#tag' === $type && 'BR' === $processor->get_tag() ) {
				$text .= ' ';
			}
		}

		if ( null !== $processor->get_last_error() ) {
			return null;
		}

		return $found ? $text : '';
	}

	/**
	 * Reads caption text with a linear Tag Processor token walk.
	 *
	 * @param string $html Block HTML.
	 * @return string Caption text.
	 */
	private static function get_caption_text_with_tag_processor( $html ) {
		$processor  = new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );
		$text       = '';
		$in_caption = false;

		while ( $processor->next_token() ) {
			$type = $processor->get_token_type();

			if ( '#tag' === $type ) {
				$tag = $processor->get_tag();

				if ( 'FIGCAPTION' === $tag ) {
					if ( $processor->is_tag_closer() ) {
						break;
					}
					$in_caption = true;
				} elseif ( $in_caption && 'BR' === $tag ) {
					$text .= ' ';
				}
				continue;
			}

			if ( $in_caption && '#text' === $type ) {
				$text .= $processor->get_modifiable_text();
			}
		}

		return $text;
	}

	/**
	 * Collapses runs of whitespace into single spaces and trims.
	 *
	 * Operates on already-extracted plain text, not HTML.
	 *
	 * @param string $text Text.
	 * @return string
	 */
	private static function normalize_whitespace( $text ) {
		$normalized = preg_replace( '/\s+/u', ' ', (string) $text );

		return trim( is_string( $normalized ) ? $normalized : (string) $text );
	}

	/**
	 * Whether an `alt` attribute value counts as empty.
	 *
	 * @param string|true|null $alt Value from get_attribute().
	 * @return bool
	 */
	private static function is_empty_alt( $alt ) {
		return null === $alt || true === $alt || '' === trim( (string) $alt );
	}

	/**
	 * Whether a URL points to a different host than the site.
	 *
	 * @param string $href      Decoded href value.
	 * @param string $site_host Lower-cased site host.
	 * @return bool

	 * Uses WP_HTML_Processor, which understands HTML tree semantics, and falls
	 * back to a token walk with WP_HTML_Tag_Processor if the HTML Processor
	 * cannot handle the markup.
	 *
	 * @param string $html Block HTML.
	 * @return string Normalized caption text, or '' if none.
	 */
	public static function get_caption_text( $html ) {
		$text = self::get_caption_text_with_html_processor( $html );

		if ( null === $text ) {
			$text = self::get_caption_text_with_tag_processor( $html );
		}

		return self::normalize_whitespace( $text );
	}

	/**
	 * Reads caption text with the full HTML Processor.
	 *
	 * @param string $html Block HTML.
	 * @return string|null Caption text, or null if the processor bailed.
	 */
	private static function get_caption_text_with_html_processor( $html ) {
		if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_HTML_Processor' ) || ! method_exists( 'WP_HTML_Processor', 'next_token' ) ) {
			return null;
		}

		$processor = WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment( $html );
		if ( null === $processor ) {
			return null;
		}

		$text       = '';
		$in_caption = false;
		$found      = false;

		while ( $processor->next_token() ) {
			$breadcrumbs = $processor->get_breadcrumbs();
			$inside      = is_array( $breadcrumbs ) && in_array( 'FIGCAPTION', $breadcrumbs, true );

			if ( $in_caption && ! $inside ) {
				// Left the first caption; ignore any further ones.
				break;
			}
			$in_caption = $inside;

			if ( ! $inside ) {
				continue;
			}
			$found = true;

			$type = $processor->get_token_type();
			if ( '#text' === $type ) {
				$text .= $processor->get_modifiable_text();
			} elseif ( '#tag' === $type && 'BR' === $processor->get_tag() ) {
				$text .= ' ';
			}
		}

		if ( null !== $processor->get_last_error() ) {
			return null;
		}

		return $found ? $text : '';

	 * Reads caption text with a linear Tag Processor token walk.
	 *
	 * @param string $html Block HTML.
	 * @return string Caption text.
	 */
	private static function get_caption_text_with_tag_processor( $html ) {
		$processor  = new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );
		$text       = '';
		$in_caption = false;

		while ( $processor->next_token() ) {
			$type = $processor->get_token_type();

			if ( '#tag' === $type ) {
				$tag = $processor->get_tag();

				if ( 'FIGCAPTION' === $tag ) {
					if ( $processor->is_tag_closer() ) {
						break;
					}
					$in_caption = true;
				} elseif ( $in_caption && 'BR' === $tag ) {
					$text .= ' ';
				}
				continue;
			}

			if ( $in_caption && '#text' === $type ) {
				$text .= $processor->get_modifiable_text();
			}
		}

		return $text;
	}

	/**
	 * Collapses runs of whitespace into single spaces and trims.
	 *
	 * Operates on already-extracted plain text, not HTML.
	 *
	 * @param string $text Text.
	 * @return string
	 */
	private static function normalize_whitespace( $text ) {
		$normalized = preg_replace( '/\s+/u', ' ', (string) $text );

		return trim( is_string( $normalized ) ? $normalized : (string) $text );
	}

	 * Whether an `alt` attribute value counts as empty.
	 *
	 * @param string|true|null $alt Value from get_attribute().
	 * @return bool
	 */
	private static function is_empty_alt( $alt ) {
		return null === $alt || true === $alt || '' === trim( (string) $alt );
	}

	/**
	 * Whether a URL points to a different host than the site.
	 *
	 * @param string $href      Decoded href value.
	 * @param string $site_host Lower-cased site host.
	 * @return bool
	 */
	public static function is_external_url( $href, $site_host ) {
		$href = trim( $href );

		if ( '' === $href || '#' === $href[0] ) {
			return false;
		}

		$parts = wp_parse_url( $href );
		if ( ! is_array( $parts ) || empty( $parts['host'] ) ) {
			return false;
		}

		if ( isset( $parts['scheme'] ) && ! in_array( strtolower( $parts['scheme'] ), array( 'http', 'https' ), true ) ) {
			return false;
		}

		$is_external = strtolower( $parts['host'] ) !== strtolower( $site_host );

		/**
		 * Filters whether a link inside a media block is treated as external.
		 *
		 * @param bool   $is_external Whether the link is external.
		 * @param string $href        Link URL.
		 * @param string $site_host   Site host name.
		 */
		return (bool) apply_filters( 'smart_media_markup_is_external_link', $is_external, $href, $site_host );
	}

	/**
	 * Adds a token to a rel attribute value, preserving existing tokens.
	 *
	 * @param string|true|null $rel   Current value from get_attribute().
	 * @param string           $token Token to add.
	 * @return string|null New value, or null if no change is needed.
	 */
	public static function merge_rel( $rel, $token ) {
		$existing = is_string( $rel ) ? preg_split( '/[\t\n\f\r ]+/', trim( $rel ), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY ) : array();
		$existing = is_array( $existing ) ? $existing : array();

		foreach ( $existing as $value ) {
			if ( strtolower( $value ) === $token ) {
				return null;
			}
		}

		$existing[] = $token;

		return implode( ' ', $existing );

I've written the Smart Media Markup plugin in `./output/smart-media-markup/`. As you asked, I ran nothing: no `npm install`, no build and no PHPUnit, so none of the code has been tested.

Files:

- `smart-media-markup.php` — main plugin file (requires WordPress 6.5+ and PHP 7.4+).
- `includes/class-smart-media-markup.php` — connects the plugin to WordPress:
  - registers the `smartMediaCaptionAsAlt` attribute on `core/image` through `register_block_type_args`;
  - adds the three `render_block_core/image`, `/gallery` and `/cover` filters;
  - loads the editor script from `build/index.asset.php`.
- `includes/class-smart-media-markup-processor.php` — does the four transforms in one pass with `WP_HTML_Tag_Processor`:
  - **Caption text:** read with `WP_HTML_Processor`. If that can't handle the markup, it falls back to walking the HTML with the Tag Processor.
  - **External links:** a link is external when its host differs from the site's host. Relative, `#` and `mailto:` links are skipped.
  - **Filters:** `smart_media_markup_site_host` and `smart_media_markup_is_external_link` let you override the external-link check.
- `src/index.js` — registers the attribute through `blocks.registerBlockType` and adds the "Use caption as alt text" `ToggleControl` to the image block's settings sidebar (`editor.BlockEdit` + `createHigherOrderComponent`).
- `package.json` — uses `@wordpress/scripts` for `build`, `start`, `lint` and `plugin-zip`.
- `readme.txt`
- `phpunit.xml.dist`
- `tests/bootstrap.php` — the standard WordPress plugin test setup.
- `tests/test-smart-media-markup-processor.php`:
  - one data provider per transform, each with input and expected HTML;
  - tests that the attribute is registered, that `render_block` applies the changes, and that saved post content is unchanged.

  The tests compare HTML by structure (tags, attributes, text), not as exact strings, so they don't depend on where the HTML API puts a newly added attribute.

Where I had to interpret the spec:

- **Cover block and the class:** the Cover block's outer element is a `<div>`, not a `<figure>`, so it doesn't get `has-smart-media`. Images inside it still get `decoding="async"` and their links still get `rel="noopener"`. For older aligned images wrapped in `<div class="wp-block-image">`, the class goes on the `<figure>` inside that wrapper.
- **What counts as empty `alt`:** a missing `alt`, `alt=""` and an `alt` of only spaces all count as empty, so the caption text is copied in. An existing `alt` is never overwritten, and an existing `decoding` value is left as it is.

There are no forms or saved settings, so no capability or nonce checks were needed.

  - one data provider per transform, each with input and expected HTML;
  - tests that the attribute is registered, that `render_block` applies the changes, and that saved post content is unchanged.

  The tests compare HTML by structure (tags, attributes, text), not as exact strings, so they don't depend on where the HTML API puts a newly added attribute.

Where I had to interpret the spec:

- **Cover block and the class:** the Cover block's outer element is a `<div>`, not a `<figure>`, so it doesn't get `has-smart-media`. Images inside it still get `decoding="async"` and their links still get `rel="noopener"`. For older aligned images wrapped in `<div class="wp-block-image">`, the class goes on the `<figure>` inside that wrapper.
- **What counts as empty `alt`:** a missing `alt`, `alt=""` and an `alt` of only spaces all count as empty, so the caption text is copied in. An existing `alt` is never overwritten, and an existing `decoding` value is left as it is.

There are no forms or saved settings, so no capability or nonce checks were needed.
